function: Channel estimation: a DNN generates initializations for unrolled CP alternating least squares, which denoises and decomposes the MIMO-OFDM tensor channel (p. 5, 7).
system: Downlink mmWave MIMO-OFDM, BS ULA with 32 antennas, MS ULA with 8 antennas, 128 subcarriers; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 6, 8).
method: Fully connected DNN (4 hidden layers, 512 neurons) trained end-to-end through K=2 unrolled ALS iterations; unsupervised, on noisy data without clean labels (p. 5-7).
data_channel: Synthetic geometry-based mmWave channel, R=4 paths, random AoA/AoD/delay/gain draws; 100,000 samples, 90,000 train and 10,000 test; synthetic random CP tensors also used (p. 7-8).
test_conditions: Trained on mixed SNRs from 5 to 25 dB, tested at each SNR on 10,000 held-out samples of the same distribution; ALS iterations K=2 training, K=50 test (p. 8).
baselines: Non-learned: Random-CPALS, SVD-CPALS, GEVD-CPALS (synthetic only), SCPD subspace method, MMSE. Learned: SFCNN supervised CNN denoiser [37] (p. 7-9).
metrics: Objective value of CP approximation, average normalized squared error (ANSE) and its CDF, parameter-estimation ANSE (AoA, AoD, delay), iterations needed for a target ANSE (p. 8-10).
complexity: Complexity orders and kilo-flops per method (Table III); DNN 1,884,160 flops, 1,886,304 parameters, 7.2 MB; initialization 0.6 ms, ALS 22 ms at K=50 (p. 8, 10).
openness: none (the only repository cited, github.com/phdong21/CNN4CE, is the baseline SFCNN code, p. 9).
q1_support: p. 6: "geometry-based channel model that has R resolvable paths without clustering"; custom synthetic model following [37], with no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "10.000 samples are selected randomly for testing and the rest 90.000 samples are used for training"; only SNR is swept, no new scenario, array size or dataset.
q3_support: p. 9: "comparison of the channel estimation ANSE between the supervised SFCNN, the subspace-type SCPD and the CPALS algorithm"; MMSE, SCPD and SVD-CPALS are non-learned, SFCNN is the earlier learned estimator.
q4_support: p. 10: "proposed DL-CPALS requires 1884160 flops"; Table III on the same page gives complexity orders and kilo-flops.
q5_support: p. 9: "Other settings are the same as in the open-source codes of the paper"; this is the baseline SFCNN code. No code or data link for DL-CPALS, and its data are synthetic (p. 8).
notes: Included, area 2: the DNN-initialized unrolled CPALS performs MIMO-OFDM channel estimation (denoising). The channel is a custom geometry-based simulator following [37], so q1 is 0. SFCNN beats DL-CPALS at 5 dB (p. 9) but the comparison counts for q3. Tables II and III were read from the page image (p. 10).
